locations.label: Janus Towers Plaza
locations.description: Starting plaza: find Ol' Tessie, the Server Room and the Stabilizer Chip encounter.

locations.label: Janus Towers · Server Room
locations.description: Room containing Quick Revive. Collect T.E.D.D.'s head, free Stun Grenade and the song headphones here. Room highlight uses the verified nearby perk position.

locations.label: Vandorn Farm
locations.description: Farm complex with Farmhouse, Barn, Cellar and Garage. Individual buildings have separate area markers.

locations.label: Vandorn Farm · Farmhouse
locations.description: Stamin-Up building: dining clock and Pa, Tasty-Face bunk bed, red candle and the TV Twins. Search the described furniture; this is a room-area marker.

locations.label: Vandorn Farm · Barn
locations.description: Death Perception building: power switch, hanging corpse, upstairs toy horse and Grim relic portal. Upper and lower floors share this overview.
locations.floor: Ground floor; upstairs where stated in the step

locations.label: Vandorn Farm · Cellar
locations.description: Underground room near the MK.78 / Arsenal. Necrofluid cube and Ma's Chalice bathtub. Marker uses the building footprint; the cellar is below it.

locations.label: Vandorn Farm · Garage
locations.description: Garage near the Armor Vest: Pa's Pigsticker ritual item. Building-area highlight.

locations.label: Blackwater Lake
locations.description: Cabin, Toolshed, Boathouse and pier area.

locations.label: Blackwater Lake · Cabin
locations.description: Speed Cola building. Find the Jar of Spores under the kitchen cabinet, projector, film reels, Hellion Horn box and interior relic portals.
locations.floor: Ground floor; upper floor where described

locations.label: Blackwater Lake · back of Cabin
locations.description: Ammo Cache side of the Cabin: film reel beneath the stairs and Klaus waiting with the Hellion Horn. Approximate area around the official Ammo Cache.

locations.label: Blackwater Lake · Toolshed
locations.description: Crafting Table building: fertilizer canister, film reel and axe-throwing trophy. Building-area highlight.

locations.label: Blackwater Lake · pier / Boathouse
locations.description: Pier and Boathouse at the lakeside north of the Cabin. Interact with the floating soul, check the overhead film reel, and find the boat-house relic portal. Approximate shore area, not an exact object pin.

locations.label: Ashwood
locations.description: Town center between the northern and southern travel loops.

locations.label: Ashwood · Sheriff's Office
locations.description: Akita wall-buy building by Market Square. Put the Stabilizer Chip in the cell panel and revive Klaus. Building area, not the panel position.

locations.label: Ashwood · The Ruby Rabbit
locations.description: Jugger-Nog building. Stun Grenade shelf, red candle and song/side quest items are inside. Building area.

locations.label: Ashwood · Ruby Alley
locations.description: Alley near the X9 Maverick wall-buy. Deliver the three keys to the Seal of Sorrow. Approximate alley area.

locations.label: Ashwood · Judgement Square
locations.description: VS Recon wall-buy area. Song headphones and fertilizer canister are in this square.

locations.label: Ashwood · Market Square
locations.description: Vulture Aid area and Ashwood power-switch side.

locations.label: Ashwood · Vehicle Upgrade Station
locations.description: Drive Ol' Tessie to the garage door to install upgrades. Ashwood building-area guidance; the exact garage-door coordinate has not been surveyed.

locations.label: Ashwood · Tailor Shop
locations.description: Town shop containing the mirror for Powder of the Forgotten. Approximate western-shop area; exact mirror position not surveyed.

locations.label: Ashwood · floating clock tower
locations.description: Aim upwards at the clock tower above Ashwood. Freeze its faces using the DG-2 turret, then obtain purple Gauntlet charges. This ground-area highlight does not show the floating tower height.

locations.label: Zarya Cosmodrome
locations.description: Cosmodrome complex: Yuri's Lab, Support Systems, Control Room and the launch area.

locations.label: Zarya Cosmodrome · Yuri's Lab
locations.description: Laboratory in the cosmodrome building complex. Read the chalkboard, add ingredients, then defend the Serum. Approximate building area, not the worktable coordinate.

locations.label: Zarya Cosmodrome · Control Room
locations.description: Room near the Armor Vest: radar-dish challenge and pigpen / number monitors. The dishes are above/outside the room.

locations.label: Zarya Cosmodrome · Support Systems
locations.description: Crafting Table building: send Klaus to the panel, stand in the scanner and collect the Aether Barrel. Room-area highlight.

locations.label: Zarya Cosmodrome · launch area
locations.description: Flame Trench / launch area, including the yellow relic trial portals. Follow the described launch-pad or Exfil-cabin landmark; exact portal positions not surveyed.

locations.label: Exit 115
locations.description: Service area with Reba's Diner, McDougal's Service Station and the shipping container.

locations.label: Exit 115 · Reba's Diner
locations.description: Elemental Pop building: Cook zombie, freezer, Abomination carcass, free Tomahawk and waitress cash register. Room-area highlight.

locations.label: Exit 115 · McDougal's Service Station
locations.description: Deadshot Daiquiri building: shoot the clock and send Klaus to the mechanic in the garage. Room-area highlight.

locations.label: Exit 115 · cargo container
locations.description: Cargo container opposite the Service Station. Ram it with Tessie to revive the trucker. Approximate roadside area; exact container not surveyed.

locations.label: Monolith Forest
locations.description: Northwestern fog road between Janus Towers and Blackwater Lake. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Collapsed Tower
locations.description: Northeastern fog road between Janus Towers and Vandorn Farm. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Grounded Ship
locations.description: Ship on the road between Vandorn Farm and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Lost Cabins
locations.description: Cabins on the road between Blackwater Lake and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Crashed Rocket
locations.description: Fog road between Ashwood and Zarya Cosmodrome. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Crashed Plane
locations.description: Southern fog road between Zarya Cosmodrome and Exit 115. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Orda Graveyard
locations.description: Southwestern fog road between Exit 115 and Ashwood. Region highlight; candidate items and soul-orb positions inside this region are not individually surveyed.

locations.label: Veytharion's Sepulcher
locations.description: Detached temple visible west of Blackwater Lake. This is the boss destination, not a driving entrance; completing the soul-orb collection teleports you inside. Interior combat positions are not shown.

Starting at Round 8 , go to Janus Towers Plaza, and check the wreckage opposite of the Warden 308 wall-buy. A Uber Klaus w…
targets.description: Starting at Round 8 , go to Janus Towers Plaza, and check the wreckage opposite of the Warden 308 wall-buy. A Uber Klaus will spawn. Killing it will drop the Stabilizer Chip.

targets.title: Bring the Stabilizer Chip to Sherrif's Office at Ashwood and place it on the cell panel. It will say "Update requires rest…
targets.description: Bring the Stabilizer Chip to Sherrif's Office at Ashwood and place it on the cell panel. It will say "Update requires restart".

targets.title: Throw rapidly several Stun Grenades inside the cell to bring Klaus back online. Klaus will break free, and the Klaus Remot…
targets.description: Throw rapidly several Stun Grenades inside the cell to bring Klaus back online. Klaus will break free, and the Klaus Remote Control will become available. You can get a free Stun Grenade inside the Server Room at Janus Towers and on a shelf next to Juggernog in The Ruby Rabbit at Ashwood.

targets.title: Bring Klaus to the Zarya Cosmodrome and send it in front of the panel in Support Systems, next to one of the purchasable d…
targets.description: Bring Klaus to the Zarya Cosmodrome and send it in front of the panel in Support Systems, next to one of the purchasable doors. Klaus will reactivate the panel which will trigger a scanner next to it. Stay inside the scanner and survive until it is completed. If done correctly, the Aether Barrel will be available to be picked up.

targets.title: Bring the Aether Barrel to the Power Pump at either of the three locations (Ashwood, Blackwater Lake, Vandorn Farm) and pl…
targets.description: Bring the Aether Barrel to the Power Pump at either of the three locations (Ashwood, Blackwater Lake, Vandorn Farm) and place it inside. The barrel will be charged with Refined Energy. Once it is charged, pick the barrel up again and bring it to the Power Pumps at the other two locations. You will have a limited time to do it, and the timer resets with every charge.

targets.title: Bring the fully charged Aether Barrel next to the cube in the Cellar of Vandorn Farm to make it absorb the Aether energy.
targets.description: Bring the fully charged Aether Barrel next to the cube in the Cellar of Vandorn Farm to make it absorb the Aether energy.

targets.title: Use a Jump Pad to see three alchemical symbols on the rooftops around Vandorn Farm. Input the symbols on each side of cube…
targets.description: Use a Jump Pad to see three alchemical symbols on the rooftops around Vandorn Farm. Input the symbols on each side of cube then interact with the red eye on the fourth side of the cube to receive the Necrofluid Gauntlet. This will trigger a short lockdown where you need to shoot the green orbs around you and reload the wonder weapon to acquire them.

targets.title: Once all the orbs are collected, the Necrofluid Gauntlet is fully usable.
targets.description: Once all the orbs are collected, the Necrofluid Gauntlet is fully usable.

targets.title: Ol' Tessie is the primary vehicle to move around the map. The truck is first found in Janus Towers Plaza and requires to p…
targets.description: Ol' Tessie is the primary vehicle to move around the map. The truck is first found in Janus Towers Plaza and requires to place T.E.D.D.'s Head in the truck to power it up. The head can be found in the Server Room. Once the truck is powered-up, several upgrades are available.

targets.title: Drive through the Collapsed Tower to reach Vandorn Farm, destroy the growth infestation around the Power Pump. Once done, …
targets.description: Drive through the Collapsed Tower to reach Vandorn Farm, destroy the growth infestation around the Power Pump. Once done, interact with the power switch in the Barn.

targets.title: Drive through the Grounded Ship to reach Ashwood, destroy the growth infestation around the Power Pump at Ashwood Bridge. …
targets.description: Drive through the Grounded Ship to reach Ashwood, destroy the growth infestation around the Power Pump at Ashwood Bridge. Once done, interact with the power switch on the Market Square side of Ashwood.

targets.title: Drive Ol' Tessie next to the garage door in Ashwood to open it. Interact with the Vehicle Upgrade Station to upgrade Ol' T…
targets.description: Drive Ol' Tessie next to the garage door in Ashwood to open it. Interact with the Vehicle Upgrade Station to upgrade Ol' Tessie and install the Pack-a-Punch Machine to it. This will unlock the Pack-a-Punch for the rest of the match.

targets.title: Kill the Cook zombie in Reba's Diner at Exit 115 to drop the Freeze Key.
targets.description: Kill the Cook zombie in Reba's Diner at Exit 115 to drop the Freeze Key.

targets.title: Open the freezer in the same location to find the Abomination Carcass.
targets.description: Open the freezer in the same location to find the Abomination Carcass.

targets.title: Bring the Abomination Heads to the Ashwood garage to upgrade Ol' Tessie.
targets.description: Bring the Abomination Heads to the Ashwood garage to upgrade Ol' Tessie.

targets.title: Bruin Key (Crashed Rocket; Yellow) - This key will force you to use a Knife while holding it.
targets.description: Bruin Key (Crashed Rocket; Yellow) - This key will force you to use a Knife while holding it.

targets.title: Nightbird Key (Orda Graveyard; Red) - This key will put you at extremely low health while holding it .
targets.description: Nightbird Key (Orda Graveyard; Red) - This key will put you at extremely low health while holding it .

targets.title: Terrapin Key (Grounded Ship; Green) - This key will slow you down significantly while holding it .
targets.description: Terrapin Key (Grounded Ship; Green) - This key will slow you down significantly while holding it .

targets.title: Bring each key to the Seal of Sorrow in Ruby Alley at Ashwood to remove the chains. Note that you cannot use the Jump Pads…
targets.description: Bring each key to the Seal of Sorrow in Ruby Alley at Ashwood to remove the chains. Note that you cannot use the Jump Pads, as they will make you drop the key at the pad location.

targets.title: If done correctly, a cinematic will play and the DG-2 Turret Barrel will be available. Bring it back to the Ashwood garage…
targets.description: If done correctly, a cinematic will play and the DG-2 Turret Barrel will be available. Bring it back to the Ashwood garage to upgrade Ol' Tessie.

targets.title: Buy Wisp Tea and travel to the Tailor Shop at Ashwood. Activate the Wisp Tea's spirit and it will go inside the mirror, re…
targets.description: Buy Wisp Tea and travel to the Tailor Shop at Ashwood. Activate the Wisp Tea's spirit and it will go inside the mirror, revealing the Seal of Sorrow. Shoot the mirror with the Necrofuild Gauntlet to drop the Powder of the Forgotten. Alternatively, you can acquire all the ingredients first, see after the table.

targets.title: Travel to the Zarya Cosmodrome and reach Yuri's Lab. Interact with the powder on the table to reveal three pigpen ciphers …
targets.description: Travel to the Zarya Cosmodrome and reach Yuri's Lab. Interact with the powder on the table to reveal three pigpen ciphers on the chalkboard above the table. The ciphers indicate which ingredient will need to be acquired. Read the rows from top to bottom.

targets.title: Widow's Lantern : Get the Jar of Spores from under Cabin's kitchen cabinet at Blackwater Lake. Interact with the horse cor…
targets.description: Widow's Lantern : Get the Jar of Spores from under Cabin's kitchen cabinet at Blackwater Lake. Interact with the horse corpse covered with mushrooms at Vandorn Farm. Wait 3 rounds then interact again.

targets.title: Ravager Eyes : Kill a Ravager with a Saw Trap.
targets.description: Ravager Eyes : Kill a Ravager with a Saw Trap.

targets.title: Human Bones : Throw a Tomahawk at the foot of the hanging corpse dripping blood in the middle of the Barn at Vandorn Farm.…
targets.description: Human Bones : Throw a Tomahawk at the foot of the hanging corpse dripping blood in the middle of the Barn at Vandorn Farm. If done correctly the foot will drop. Throw a Molotov Cocktail to burn it. You can get a free Tomahawk at the diner in Exit 115, or by triggering the Axe Throwing easter egg at Blackwater Lake (see Side Quests and Easter Eggs section). There is also a free Molotov Cocktail on a barrel next to the Ashwood garage .

targets.title: Interact with each ingredient following the order shown on the chalkboard (top to bottom).

targets.title: Kill the zombies to gather their souls inside the Serum. If done correctly, the room will be filled with a purple gas and …
targets.description: Kill the zombies to gather their souls inside the Serum. If done correctly, the room will be filled with a purple gas and the lockdown will end.

targets.title: After upgrading Ol' Tessie with the DG-2 Turret, use the turret and shoot at the clock tower floating above Ashwood. Doing…
targets.description: After upgrading Ol' Tessie with the DG-2 Turret, use the turret and shoot at the clock tower floating above Ashwood. Doing so will freeze the clocks on the tower.

targets.title: With the Necrofluid Gauntlet, shoot at any of the clock faces and pull back. This will turn the Gauntlet into a purple and…
targets.description: With the Necrofluid Gauntlet, shoot at any of the clock faces and pull back. This will turn the Gauntlet into a purple and transparent version. The effect is limited in time, you can have three purple charges per round (1 for each side with a frozen clock face). Additionally, shooting the Gauntlet will remove the effect.

targets.title: Stand above the numeral corresponding to the one on the clock then look at Pa at the end of the table. If done correctly, …
targets.description: Stand above the numeral corresponding to the one on the clock then look at Pa at the end of the table. If done correctly, Pa's head will turn towards you with his eyes turning red. Shoot Pa's head with the purple Gauntlet to spawn four energy orbs that will fly away.

If done correctly, the monitors inside the Control Room will light up and three souls will float above the chairs. You have a limited time to do so, and you need to shoot the radar dishes again if you fail.

targets.title: The other six monitors will cycle through numbers. Use the selector above to reveal the correct sequence, then lock each n…
targets.description: The other six monitors will cycle through numbers. Use the selector above to reveal the correct sequence, then lock each number from left to right by shooting the red button.

targets.title: If done correctly, the souls will disappear and the Soyuz rocket will launch.
targets.description: If done correctly, the souls will disappear and the Soyuz rocket will launch.

Alternatively, you can manually trigger the lightning strikes by shooting at three light poles with lightning sparks around the area using the DG-2 Turret on Ol' Tessie. Shooting at one pole will cause another random pole to have sparks.

targets.title: Lead each zombie to its corresponding colored lightning, and they will be stunned and disappear afterwards. If the timer r…
targets.description: Lead each zombie to its corresponding colored lightning, and they will be stunned and disappear afterwards. If the timer runs out while doing this, the lightning will despawn and players have to wait until the next round to manually trigger the lightning again, or for them to naturally spawn. Players also have to shoot at the clock with the purple Gauntlet again to trigger the time stop. Once all three zombies are led to their lightning bolts, the process will be completed, as noted by the Entity's dialogue.

Each location has three orbs in total. This process has an unspecified time limit, after which the orbs will despawn, and players will have to restart the process by interacting with Klaus again.
